source.description: Where to read the app from. Omit to infer: github when owner/repoUrl is given, otherwise local.

repo.description: Path to a local clone directory (source=local).

branch.description: Branch (source=github). Defaults to the repo default branch.

appPath.description: Path to the app module inside the repo (monorepo). Default ".".

comparePlan.description: Also build the upgrade plan so findings the upgrade already fixes are separated from findings that still need action. Default true. Set false for a faster, plain vulnerability list.

refresh.description: Bypass the cached OSV answers for this run.

maxVulnDetails.description: Cap on advisory detail fetches (default 250). Counts stay complete; per-advisory detail beyond the cap is truncated and reported as such.
